footer.tagline: Fassarar mafarkai ta AI kyauta a cikin harsuna 60 — kowane al'adu, hangen naku.

home.heroTitle: Abin da {accent} naku yake ƙoƙarin faɗa
home.heroLede: Alamomin tsohon da aka gada, ilimin halin dan adam na zamani, da AI — duk haɗe cikin fassarar bayyananniya. Bayyana mafarki a cikin kalmominku kuma ku sami fassara ta al'addar da kuka amince da ita.
home.whyTitle: Fassarar da za ku iya amfani da ita
home.whyLede: Dreamscope yana haɗa mafarkinku da alamominsa, sannan ya karanta su ta al'addar da kuka amince da ita — tare da ilimin halin dan adam a gefen, ba maye gurbinsa ba.
home.feature1Body: Kowane mafarki ana haɗa shi da manyan alamominsa kuma a bi shi ta ƙarni na al'addar fassara.
home.feature2Body: Fassara ku karanta alamomi a Turanci, Larabci, Sipaniyancin, Sinanci, Jafananci, da sauran harsuna 55.
home.feature3Body: Binciken zurfin hangen nesa da ra'ayoyi a cikin bangaski — karatu ɗaya, wanda aka gani ta hangen naku.
home.feature4Body: Mafarkanku suna kan na'urarku ta tsoho. Shiga don daidaita a cikin na'urori.
home.sampleDream: "Na ga maciji kore yana fita daga gidan ta ƙofar lambu."
home.sampleReading: Maciji yana nuna canjis wuri — wani abu a rayuwarku yana shedding tsofaffin fatar jikinsa. Ƙofa tana nuna fita bayyananniya tana buɗewa. A cikin al'adu da yawa, maciji marar cutarwa wanda ya bar gida sau da yawa yana nuna damuwa mai ɗorewa ta ƙarshe tana tafiya.
home.symbolsLede: Daga ruwa zuwa wuta, bincika mafi yawan abubuwan da ke bayyana a cikin mafarkai da abin da kowane yake nuna a cikin al'adu.
home.ctaLede: Jimillar jumla kaɗan iske ne. Karatu yana ɗaukar daƙiƙa kaɗan kuma yana zauna a kan na'urarku ta tsoho.

interpret.title: Bayyana mafarkinku
interpret.lede: Rubuta shi da kalmominku. Mafi yawan bayani, mafi tsananin karatu — wurin, abubuwan da kuka ji, da dukak abin da ba na al'ada ba duk suna da muhimmanci.
interpret.placeholder: Jiya dare na yi mafarkin ina taɓa ƙofa waddake take canza siffa…
interpret.savedConfirm: An ajiye a cikin littafin ku. Ku same shi a duk lokacin a ƙarƙashin An ajiye.
interpret.disclaimer: Tunani ne kawai — ba shawara ta likita, ta ilimin hali, ko ta addi ni ba. Ba yana hasashen gaba ba.
interpret.errorEmpty: Da fatan za a fara bayyana mafarkinku.
interpret.errorFailed: Fassara ta gaza. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa.
interpret.errorNetwork: Kuskuren haɗi. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa.
interpret.perspNotice: Kowane al'ada ana nuna su daban. Karatuttuka suna tunani ne da yuwuwar — ba hasashe ba.
interpret.compareDesc: Mafarki ɗaya, karanta ta kowane hangen nesa sau ɗaya — ga inda al'adu suka yarda da inda suka bambantasu.
interpret.thanks: Na gode — feedback ɗinku yana inganta karatuttuka na gaba.
interpret.perspectiveDesc: Karatu ɗaya wanda ke haɗa mafi hikimar zaren al'adun duniya tare da zurfin ilimin halin dan adam.
interpret.exampleDream: Jiya dare na yi mafarkin saniya fari ta sauka a kan taguwata, sannan ta zama wasiƙar da ban iya karantawa ba. Na ji natsuwa amma ina da sha'awa.

about.title: Karatu bayyananniya, wanda aka tushunta a al'ada
about.p1: Dreamscope yana wanzu don sa fassarar mafarkai ta zama mai sauƙi a cikin naku harshe da yanayin al'adunku. Muna jawo daga faffaɗan al'adun fassara — ilimin addini da na ruhaniya, al'adun gargajiya, da tsafuran alama na zamani na zurfin ilimin halin dan adam — don ku iya karanta mafarkinku ta hangen nesa da kuka amince da shi.
about.p2: Kowane karatu ana samar da shi don taimaka muku yin tunani — ba don hasashen gaba ba. Alamomi kamar ruwa, wuta, tashi, ko maciji suna ɗaukar ma'ana a cikin al'adu na dubun shekaru, kuma fassarar mu suna bi waɗannan zaren don ku sami abin da ya yi daidai da rayuwarku.
about.p3: Sabis ɗa kyauta ne, na sirri ta ƙira, kuma yana samuwa a cikin harsuna 60. Rubutun mafarkinku ana aika shi ga sabis ɗin fassararmu don samar da karatu, sannan ba mu ajiye shi ba; karatuttukanku suna kan na'urarku sai kun shiga kuma ku daidaita.
about.card1Body: Hangen nesa na Musulunci, Kirista, Yahudawa, Hindu, Buddist, Sinanci, da na hankali — zaɓi wanda kuka amince da shi.
about.card2Body: Daga Larabci zuwa Jafananci — fassara a cikin harshen da kuka yi mafarki.
about.card3Body: Karatuttukanku suna kan na'urarku ta tsoho. Shiga kawai don daidaita; share a duk lokacin.
about.traditionsLede: Zaɓi hangen nesa da zuciyarku ta amince da shi — kowane karatu ana samar da shi ta hanyar makarantar fassara ta musamman.

contact.title: Tuntuɓe mu
contact.lede: Tambayoyi, gyare-gyare, ko ra'ayoyin haɗin gwiwa? Aika wa ƙungiyar Dreamscope ta imel.
contact.disclaimer: Dreamscope yana ba da tunani da nishadi kawai. Fassarar ba shawara ta likita, ta ilimin hali, ko ta addi ba. Idif kuka bujma tallafi, da fatan za a tuntuɓe ƙwararren mai fasaha.

faq.title: Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi
faq.a1: Dreamscope yana haɗa ilimin mafarkai duma al'adu da bangaski da yawa — ciki har da Musulunci, Kirista, Yahudawa, Hindu, Buddist, da Sinanci — tare da zurfin ilimin halin dan adam na zamani. Kuna bayyana mafarki a cikin kalmominku kuma kuka sami karatu wanda ke haɗa alamominsa da mafi yawan ma'anansu a cikin al'adu.
faq.q2: Shin bayan mafarkinmu na sirri ne?
faq.a2: Eh. Mafarkanku ana adana su ne kawai a cikin ma'ajiyar gida ta mai bincikenku a kan na'urarku. Ba a aika komai zuwa uwar garke don adana shi ba, kuma za ku iya share tarihinku a duk lokacin.
faq.q3: A cikin waɗanne harsuna zan iya fassara mafarkai?
faq.a3: Dreamscope yana goyon bayan harsuna 60 ciki har da Turanci, Larabci, Sipaniyancin, Faransanci, Jamusanci, Sinanci, Jafananci, Koreanci, Turkiyancin, Fotugisancin, Rashanci, Hindi, da ƙari. Karatu yana bi harshen da kuka zaɓa.
faq.q4: Shin fassarar su maye gurbin shawara ta ƙwararren mai fasaha?
faq.a4: A'a. Karatuttukan mafarkai suna don tunani da nishadi ne. Ba shawara ta likita, ta ilimin hali, ko ta addi ba. Idif kuna fuskur wahala, da fatan za a yi magana da ƙwararren mai fasaha.
faq.q5: Dabboben alama nawa ne aka rufe?
faq.a5: Dreamscope yana da shafuka na musamman don alamomi na yau da kullum 146 — maciji, ruwa, tashi, wuta, juna biyu, kuɗi, da ƙari — kowane yana samuwa a cikin harsuna da yawa tare da bambance-bambancen tambaya na dogon wutsiya.

profile.title: Wurinku
profile.cloudOff: Rubutun mafarkinku ana aika shi ga sabis ɗin fassararmu don samar da karatu, sannan ba mu ajiye shi ba. Karatuttuka ana kiyaye su a kan na'urarku sai kun shiga kuka zaɓi daidaita. Ba mu taɓa sayarwa ko yin bayani akan bayananku ba.
profile.dataNote: Inda bayananku ke zaune: na'urarku ta tsoho. Idif kun shiga, littafin ku na iya daidaita zuwa asusunku na sirri; za ku iya share shi a duk lokacin.
profile.signInLede: Shiga don kiyaye littafin mafarkinku a duk na'urorinku. Tarihin baƙo yana tafiya da ku ta atomatik.
profile.checkEmail: Duba akwatin saƙonku — hanyar shiga tana jira ku.
profile.invalidEmail: Da fatan za a shigar da ingantaccen adireshin imel.
profile.signInError: Ba za mu iya shiga ku ba. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa ko amfani da hanyar imel.
profile.googleNotEnabled: Shiga da Google ba a kunna shi a kan wannan aikin ba. Mai shafin yana buƙatar haɗa abokin cinikin Google OAuth a Supabase.
profile.guestNote: Bai wa kalmar wucewa ba, babu bin diddigi — kawai hanyar haɗi. Yanayin baƙo tare da ajiya a kan na'ura yana cikin girma.
profile.migrated: An ƙaura mafarkai {n} daga wannan na'ura zuwa littafinku.
profile.lede: Duk abin da Dreamscope ya sani game da tafiyarku — wanda aka adana a kan na'urarku, naku kaɗai.
profile.emptyState: Ba a da mafarkai ba — karatunku na farko zai haskaka wannan shafin.
profile.symbolsYouMeet: Alamomi da kuke ci gaba da saduwa
profile.languagesUsed: Harsunan da aka yi amfani da su
profile.perspectivesUsed: Al'adun da aka yi amfani da su
profile.connected: An haɗa — yanzu za ku iya shiga da daidaita littafinku.
profile.connectError: Ba za a iya haɗawa ba. Duba URL da maɓallin anon.
profile.privacyNote: Mafarkanku ana adana su ne a kan na'urarku — ba a taɓa sayarwa ba, ba a taɓa yin bayani akan su ba.
profile.autoSetupBody: Babu aiki har yanzu? Gudanar da rubutun bootstrap sau ɗaya: yana ƙirƙira aikin Supabase, yana amfasa tsarin bayanai, kuma yana buga URL + maɓallin anon don manna a sama. Shiga da Google yana buƙatar abokin cinikin Google Cloud OAuth (duba rubutun).

perspDesc.general: Karatu ɗaya wanda ke haɗa mafi hikimar zaren al'adun duniya tare da zurfin ilimin halin dan adam.
perspDesc.islamic: Makarantar gargajiya ta Ibn Sirin — alama, doka, da mai da hankali ga rai.
perspDesc.christian: Karatun mafarki a cikin zuriyar Yusufu da Daniel, tare da alamar Nassi.
perspDesc.jewish: Hikimar mafarkai ta Tura da Talmud — saƙo yana jiran hikimar fassara.
perspDesc.hindu: Alamomin Vedic, karma, da yanayen ciki na hankali.
perspDesc.buddhist: Rashin dawwama da wayewar mai hankali — lura da mafarki ba tare da ɗauka ba.
perspDesc.psychology: Prototypes na Jung da inuwa — abin da psikikinku yake sarrafawa.
perspDesc.chinese: Kamus ɗin gargajiya na Zhou Gong — ma'auni na yin, yang, da abubuwa biyar.

seo.traditionsBody: Alama na iya nufin abubuwa daban a cikin al'adu daban-daban. A cikin Musulunci, Kirista, Yahudawa, Hindu, Buddist, Sinanci, da al'adun hankali, hoton ɗaya ana karanta shi ta nasa hangen nesa. Zaɓi hangen nesa da kuka amince da shi a shafin fassara.
seo.tryLede: Raba mafarkinku kuma ku sami fassarar AI da aka keɓance muku.
seo.reflectNote: Wannan shafi yana don tunani da nishadi kawai. Ba shawara ta likita, ta ilimin hali, ko ta addi ba, kuma ba yana hasashen gaba ba.
